description.en: Llama-based open-weight TTS model for 23-language speech synthesis with one-shot voice cloning from short reference audio and automatic word-alignment support.
description.zh: 基于 Llama 的开源权重 TTS 模型，支持 23 种语言语音合成，可从短参考音频单样本克隆音色，并支持自动词对齐。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated audio tokens per chunk. When omitted, OuteTTS estimates a safe value from each chunk.
max_tokens.zh: 每个分块最多生成的音频 token 数。省略时 OuteTTS 会按每个分块估算一个安全值。

temperature.en: Sampling temperature; default 0.4 for cloning, otherwise model config default.
temperature.zh: 采样温度；克隆时默认 0.4，否则取模型配置默认值。

top_k.en: Top-k sampling; default 40 for cloning, otherwise model config default.
top_k.zh: Top-k 采样；克隆时默认 40，否则取模型配置默认值。

top_p.en: Nucleus sampling in (0, 1]; default 0.9 for cloning, otherwise model config default.
top_p.zh: 核采样，取值 (0, 1]；克隆时默认 0.9，否则取模型配置默认值。

min_p.en: Minimum probability relative to the best token; default 0.05 for cloning, otherwise model config default.
min_p.zh: 相对于最优 token 的最小概率；克隆时默认 0.05，否则取模型配置默认值。

repetition_penalty.en: Windowed repetition penalty; must be > 0, default 1.1.
repetition_penalty.zh: 窗口重复惩罚；必须 > 0，默认 1.1。

seed.en: Sampling seed; cloning defaults to 4099 for native weights and 42 for quantized weights.
seed.zh: 采样随机种子；克隆时原生权重默认 4099、量化权重默认 42。

reference_text.en: Transcript matching the reference voice audio for voice cloning.
reference_text.zh: 音色克隆时与参考语音音频对应的文本。

reference_language.en: Language code used to align the reference transcript; omitted inherits the request text language, then falls back to en.
reference_language.zh: 用于对齐参考成绩单的语言代码；省略继承请求文本语言，然后回退到 en。

repetition_window.zh: 最近 token 惩罚窗口；默认 64。

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum UTF-8 codepoints per long-form text chunk; default 256. Chunks are split further when required by max_tokens or context budget.
text_chunk_size.zh: 每个长文本分块的最大 UTF-8 码点数；默认 256。受 max_tokens 或上下文预算限制时会进一步切分。

text_chunk_mode.en: Framework long-form text chunking mode; default word_budget.
text_chunk_mode.zh: 框架长文本分块模式；默认 word_budget。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=report peak (docs/reports)
